description: Save one memory (a preference or project fact) for this learner. Writing the same kind again replaces it.

kind.description: Kind for this memory. At least 1 character. Example: "study_preference" or "project_learning_context". Writing the same kind again replaces the previous memory.

project_id.description: UUID of the project this memory belongs to, or null. Example: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. Omit or null to store a learner-wide memory.

value.description: JSON object to store. Usual shape: { "content": "the memory text" }. Other keys are allowed.

name: write-memory

projectId.description: Owning project UUID, or null for global memory.

updatedAt.description: Last write timestamp of the row.

title: Write Studocu Agent Memory
